findingVerification.notes: The benchmark warden.toml explicitly sets defaults.verification.enabled = true.

traceCapture.notes: Run used --traces on all six published shards. Raw JSONL artifacts are withheld pending sensitive-data review; committed traceSummaries retain sanitized per-chunk metadata only.

timing.notes: The published row aggregates six clean shard artifacts. First attempts for two shards are excluded after one extraction failure in each. Clean-shard timing remains operational context and is not ranked.

scoring.notes: Agent-verified semantic matches. A final finding counts only when it identifies the same bug at the same corpus SHA in roughly the same location. Same-file unrelated bugs and semantically unsupported merged additionalLocations do not count.

notes: Controlled Warden 0.47.0 rerun using Pi with openrouter/x-ai/grok-4.6 at high effort for scanning and openrouter/openai/gpt-5.6-luna at high effort for auxiliary extraction, verification, and merge calls. The six published shards contain 156 successful traced chunks. The primary model emitted 65 JSON finding candidates; 12 used verification arrays instead of strings and were rejected by Warden's finding schema. Schema validation and auxiliary processing reduced the scan output to 38 final findings. Two first-attempt chunks ended with reasoning but no final text even though their provider traces reported success and stop; Warden recorded extraction_no_findings_json. Their whole shard attempts are excluded from this clean row. Clean spend was $78.47; spend including the two failed shard attempts was $117.19. Primary-output and final-system scoring are recorded separately in the paired analysis. Raw JSONL artifacts are withheld pending sensitive-data review.
